frame_and_warmup.rule: Per run (full or slice): take the rows with open time in [start - 220 x 4h, end). All 18 symbols plus BTCUSDT are complete on the 4h grid, so the book's timestamp intersection keeps every bar. Indicators are computed on THIS slice only, seeded at its first row; nothing from before the warm-up start is used. Decision bars are those with open time in [start, end); the first 220 rows are warm-up only.

indicators.ema: e20, e50, e200 = pandas ewm(span=n, adjust=False) of close, seeded with the first close of the slice
indicators.atr: TR = max(h - l, |h - c_prev|, |l - c_prev|), first row TR = h - l; ATR = ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False) of TR, seeded with TR[0] (Wilder-style recursion, not an SMA seed)
indicators.ret42: c / c.shift(42) - 1 (NaN for the first 42 rows)
indicators.ret180: c / c.shift(180) - 1 (NaN for the first 180 rows)

entry_signal.rule: Long entry on closed bar i when ALL hold: xup(e20, e50) i.e. e20[i] > e50[i] and e20[i-1] <= e50[i-1]; c[i] > e200[i]; ret42[i] > 0; ret180[i] > 0. A NaN in any term means no signal. F02 applies _one_side (drop a bar with both le and se); on these data le and se are mutually exclusive (c > e200 vs c < e200), so the long signal set equals F01's.

signal_exit.rule: Long exit signal lx[i] = (e20[i] < e50[i]) OR NOT (ret42[i] > 0 AND ret180[i] > 0) (NaN counts as not > 0). Checked at the close of every managed bar, including the fill bar, after the intrabar walk; filled at close[i] with exit slippage.
signal_exit.source: strategies.py:sig_ema_mom; backtest.py:run (step 6, signal / time exits at close)

pending_and_fill.rule: A signal on decision bar i (inside the window, i + 1 < number of book bars, account not halted, symbol not currently held) becomes a pending entry filled at the OPEN of bar i + 1. A signal on a symbol that already has an open position is dropped, not queued. A signal on the last window bar never fills. Pending entries are processed in the sleeve symbol order (the fixed-18 order); when 4 positions are open or the account is halted, processing stops and every remaining pending entry is discarded.
pending_and_fill.source: backtest.py:run (fills of pending entries; new signals -> fill next candle)

sizing.rule: sl_eq = realized cash equity (eq) at the start of the bar's fill loop (fixed for all fills of that bar). risk_usd = sl_eq x 0.01. stop distance R_dist = 2.5 x ATR[i] where i is the DECISION bar (the bar before the fill). qty = risk_usd / R_dist, then capped by leverage: qty <= max(0, 10 x sl_eq - sum(open qty x close[fill bar - 1])) / fill_price (positions opened earlier in the same loop count). Legacy floor: skip if qty x fill_price < min notional. On fill: eq -= qty x fill_price x 0.0005 (entry fee booked into the trade's realized P&L). Initial stop = fill_price - R_dist; e0 = avg = fill_price.
sizing.source: backtest.py:run.open_pos; feasibility.py:risk_qty; feasibility.py:size_check; backtest.py:_sig_atr (ema_mom/exp_trend supply no own 'atr', so the book ATR of the decision bar is used); backtest.py:legacy_rule

per_bar_management_order.rule: For each window bar, in this order: (1) Cairo-calendar-day rollover resets the halt and records day_start = eq + unrealized at the previous close; (2) fill pending entries; (3) for each open position in insertion order: charge funding eq -= qty x close[i] x 0.00005; if open[i] <= stop, close all at open[i] (gap stop) and skip the rest; else walk the intrabar path; then the signal exit / time exit at close[i]; (4) liquidation check (maintenance margin 0.005 cross, at each position's adverse extreme); (5) daily halt if (eq + unrealized at close[i]) / day_start - 1 <= -0.08 (blocks fills and new signals until the next Cairo day); (6) new signals -> pending; (7) equity curve point = eq + unrealized at close[i]; stop the run if it is <= 2% of start.

intrabar_path.rule: Path points for a long: green bar (c > o): o, l, h, c; red bar (c < o): o, h, l, c; doji (c == o): o, h, l, c. The stop is tested on adverse legs only (not at the bare open, which the gap rule already handled) and fills at the stop level, or at the leg's start price if that is already through it. F02 target = e0 + 3.0 x R_dist, tested on favourable legs, fills at the target level. Stop-first: if the stop as it stood at the open lies inside the bar (low <= stop), no target can fire in that bar even if the path reaches it first. No breakeven, trail, partial, pyramid or DCA applies to either cell.

time_exit.rule: F02 only: close at close[i] when i - fill_bar >= 180 (bar indices; so at most 181 managed bars). F01 has no time exit.

exit_accounting.rule: Exit fill px' = level x (1 - 0.0002); pnl of the fill = (px' - avg) x qty - qty x px' x 0.0005. Trade realized P&L = - entry fee - all funding charges + exit pnl. Trade R = realized / risk_usd (risk_usd fixed at entry). why in {stop, tp, signal, time, liquidated}.

end_of_run.rule: Positions still open at END are not closed and are not trades; they count only in the equity curve.

stats.win_rate: share of trades with pnl > 0 (USD, not R)
stats.pf: sum of positive trade pnl / -(sum of negative trade pnl), in USD (not R): sizing compounding on equity matters
stats.max_dd_r: max drawdown of cumulative trade R in exit order: sort by (i_out, i_in), then break remaining ties by fixed-18 symbol order (matches same-bar entry / insertion order; ruling 6489310660 #6); prepend 0; max over (running max - value)
stats.max_dd_equity: min over bars of (curve / running max of curve - 1)
stats.raw_entry_signals: count of long entry signals on the 18 run symbols over decision bars in [start, end), before any slot / halt / floor filter

incomplete_rule.rule: A symbol is INCOMPLETE (excluded from the book and from every aggregate, never filled) when [warm-up start, END) on the 4h grid has any missing bar, an off-grid bar or a duplicate; BTCUSDT incomplete refuses the run.

trade_identity_fields.rule: t_in / t_out = UTC open time of the fill bar / exit bar, format %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; side = 1 for long

tolerances.trade_set: the set of (symbol, t_in, side) must match the packet exactly, per cell and per slice
tolerances.trade_exit: for every matched trade, t_out and why must match exactly
tolerances.slice_sign: exact (positive / non-positive) for each of S1-S3
tolerances.overlap: shared_exact_fills exact (131) and jaccard exact as the rational 131/200
tolerances.comparison_rule: compare the reproducer's value rounded to 6 dp with the packet value; any check outside its tolerance is DIVERGED
tolerances.win_rate: exact (count of pnl > 0 trades must match; win_rate value equal at 6 dp)

verdict_schema.overall: REPRODUCED only if every check is REPRODUCED; DIVERGED if any check is DIVERGED; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
inconclusive_when: an input file is missing or its sha256 / rows differ from the pin, or the canonical data digest does not recompute
a pinned code file hash at the cited commit differs from the pin
a packet of record file_sha256 or packet_sha256 differs from the pin
only a re-downloaded (non byte-identical) dataset is available
the reproducer could not complete (error, timeout)
a forbidden action was needed to finish
verdict_schema.first_divergence: for a DIVERGED check: the first divergent trade in (t_in, symbol) order with both sides' fields (or the missing / extra trade), plus the first failed aggregate and its delta
